name: Ink Drowning Vats
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale
description: Steel hatch doors automatically lock shut in each of the four vats labeled J2. Four ink spouts (one per vat) jut through a narrow aperture in the ceiling of each vat, 20 feet above.
disable: DC 40 Thievery check (master) to seal an ink spout, DC 48 Thievery check (master) to unlock a steel hatch door, or DC 45 Athletics check (master) to Force Open a steel hatch door
reset: The trap can be reset by refilling the ink storage tanks above the vats.
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action for each disabled ink spout. On each of the trap's actions, a spout pours ink, increasing the depth of the ink in that vat by 2 feet. Creatures standing in the ink are exposed to a dose of poison ink. Once the vat is full of ink, the trap stops using actions, but creatures in the vat might start drowning.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fill Tank
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The switch outside the vats is pulled

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Ink
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 poison damage and sickened 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 poison damage and sickened 2 (1 round)
